summary: Build with MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) - the open protocol for machine-to-machine payments over HTTP 402. Use when building paid APIs, payment-gated content or endpoints, AI agent payment flows, MCP tool payments, pay-per-token streaming, or metered pay-as-you-go billing. Covers the mppx TypeScript SDK (Hono/Express/Next.js/Elysia middleware), pympp Python SDK, and mpp Rust SDK, with Tempo stablecoins, Stripe cards, Lightning Bitcoin, and custom payment rails.
